defect.summary: The review planner classified the fix range but threw away its class, so a fix commit that touched or reverted a gate-path edit still planned a scoped second pass unless the caller passed --touched-gate by hand. An empty fix range was also accepted as if it had been read.

severity.basis: The fix adds a CLI regression test ('a fix range that touches a gate path keeps the full pass 2 without --touched-gate, and an empty range is unread') that the old code fails.
